title: The AI Cost Spike Through 2027: Who Signs the Invoice?
subtitle: Deloitte found 60 percent of finance leaders expect AI costs and technical complexity to rise substantially through 2027. Meanwhile agentic 'AI CFOs' are going to market. A composite mid-market CFO must decide what to capitalise, what to expense, and who still owns the number.
category: AI Cost Governance, Capital Allocation & Talent
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 27 September 2026. Public facts: Deloitte (CFO Dive, 15 September 2026) — 60% of finance leaders expect AI costs and technical complexity to rise substantially through 2027; 35% expect modest costs; 66% approve large AI investments via internally driven measurement-first processes; 27% of that group use stage-gate funding; 54% of finance leaders lead enterprise AI and technology capital-allocation decisions; 48% oversee AI and technology spending and cost controls. SiliconANGLE / PR Newswire, 10 September 2026: Runway Financial rebranded as cfo.ai and launched Ari, an agentic CFO connecting to NetSuite, QuickBooks, Stripe, Salesforce, Snowflake, Excel. CFO.com, 25 September 2026: Teikametrics CFO Brian Beaupre on evaluating young candidates if AI takes junior-level work. Composite firm: Coastal Packaged Foods Ltd. Composite CFO: Meera Iyer.
thumbnail: 60% OF FINANCE LEADERS EXPECT AI COSTS TO SPIKE THROUGH 2027. 54% ALREADY ALLOCATE THE AI CAPITAL.
sources: CFO Dive, 'CFOs brace for higher AI costs through 2027,' published 15 September 2026, reporting Deloitte findings. Ed Hardy, U.S. finance services leader, Deloitte.

PR Newswire, 'cfo.ai Launches an AI CFO Built for Founders,' 10 September 2026. Siqi Chen, Founder and CEO.

CFO.com sponsored, 'Businesses doing finance the old way risk stagnation. Agentic AI is the way forward,' 2026: 33% list scale use of agentic AI as a top 2026 strategic priority; collections as #1 AI use case (61%).
